code_review_findings.permission_boundary: A local plan/template or JSON cannot enter the typed permission factory. Production requires distinct externally verified owner activation and exact-plan publication comments plus reviewed implementation/test trees and the named merged PR second-parent relation. TEST_ONLY activation remains separately typed and isolated.
code_review_findings.transaction_binding: New schema2 native intent/receipt carries exact plan/action/permission IDs; recovery compares those IDs, previous pointer, target manifest hash and action timestamp. Repeated externally verified approval facts serialize into a stable permission proof; actual full-flow stability remains for the running integration to confirm.
code_review_findings.no_intent_rule: Reservation before intent or compensated soft failure consumes that operation. NO_PENDING_AUTHORIZED_SWITCH and ALREADY_RESERVED preserve the old complete version and are not publication success. This behavior is explicit in code, tests and documentation.
code_review_findings.write_boundary_scope: High-level deploy/execute reject missing or foreign permission before permission/action/bundle/pointer/mirror mutation. Existing native pointer locks and guarded transaction routines remain in use; this review does not recharacterize all low-level locking as no filesystem access.
